title: fumaria agraria var. platycarpa
intro: Fumaria agraria var. platycarpa, commonly known as Platycarpon or Broad-fruited Fumitory, is a plant species within the Fumaria genus. The health benefits of Fumaria agraria var. platycarpa include its potential to act as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant agent, which may help in managing conditions such as diabetes and cardiovascular diseases. The therapeutic actions of this plant involve its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents present in Fumaria agraria var. platycarpa include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
